ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity region spans the central axis from the peduncle to the median notch. High-intensity pixels are concentrated on the lateral lobes, featuring discrete low-intensity mottling on the left lobe and vertical low-intensity striations on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow vertex; estimated internal angle of 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire length of the trailing edge, characterized by numerous small peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 1-3% of the lobe chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral S-shaped curve exhibiting convexity on the distal outer edges and slight concavity as the contour approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 6-10 dark, roughly circular pixel clusters localized on the high-intensity distal section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four parallel vertical dark lines (potential rake marks) observed on the high-intensity surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of sessile organisms (barnacles) visible at the terminal ends of both the left and right fluke lobes, creating a textured, multi-tonal brown/white protrusion from the natural edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-brown chromatic staining (diatom accumulation) overlaying the high-intensity white regions on the ventral surface of both lobes.
